# pai daemon

The background service: status, start, stop, restart, logs

```
pai daemon <command>
```

The background service: status, start, stop, restart, logs.

```sh
pai daemon status
pai daemon logs -n 50
```

### pai daemon status

Show whether the daemon is running

```
pai daemon status
```

Show whether the daemon is running.

```sh
pai daemon status
pai daemon logs
```

See also: `pai daemon restart`, `pai daemon migrate`

### pai daemon start

Start the daemon service

```
pai daemon start
```

Start the daemon service.

Start the installed daemon service (launchd/systemd) and wait until it reports running. Does nothing if it is already running; run `pai daemon install` first if it is not installed.

```sh
pai daemon start
pai daemon status
```

See also: `pai daemon stop`, `pai daemon install`

### pai daemon stop

Stop the daemon service

```
pai daemon stop
```

Stop the daemon service.

Stop the running daemon without uninstalling it; launchd does not restart it. Start it again with `pai daemon start`. While stopped, the scheduler passes and router supervision do not run.

```sh
pai daemon stop
pai daemon status
```

See also: `pai daemon start`, `pai daemon uninstall`

### pai daemon restart

Restart the daemon

```
pai daemon restart
```

Restart the daemon.

Restart the running daemon (launchd on macOS, systemd on Linux)

```sh
pai daemon restart
pai daemon status
```

See also: `pai daemon install`, `pai daemon status`

### pai daemon logs

Show the end of the daemon log

```
pai daemon logs [options]
```

Show the end of the daemon log.

Tail the daemon log (<PAI_HOME>/logs/daemon.log)

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `-n, --lines N` | string | — | Number of lines to show |
| `-f, --follow` | flag | — | Follow log output (like tail -f) |

```sh
pai daemon logs
pai daemon logs --lines 200 --follow
```

See also: `pai daemon keepalive`

### pai daemon serve

Run the daemon in the foreground

```
pai daemon serve
```

Run the daemon in the foreground.

Start the PAI daemon in the foreground

```sh
pai daemon serve
pai daemon status
```

See also: `pai daemon migrate`

### pai daemon migrate

Copy federation data from SQLite to PostgreSQL

```
pai daemon migrate [options]
```

Copy federation data from SQLite to PostgreSQL.

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--connection-string URL` | string | — | Postgres connection string (default: from config or postgresql://pai:pai@localhost:5432/pai) |

```sh
pai daemon migrate --connection-string postgres://localhost/pai
pai daemon status
```

See also: `pai daemon status`, `pai daemon serve`

### pai daemon install

Install the daemon as a login service

```

```

Install the daemon as a login service.

Install daemon as a service (launchd/systemd) and update ~/.claude.json to use the shim

```sh

pai daemon status
```

See also: `pai daemon uninstall`, `pai daemon restart`

Remove the daemon service

```

```

Remove the daemon service.

Remove the daemon service (launchd/systemd) and revert to direct MCP

```sh

```

See also: `pai daemon keepalive`, `pai daemon install`

### pai daemon keepalive

Show session keepalive settings and recent activity

```
pai daemon keepalive
```

Show session keepalive settings and recent activity.

Show interactive-session cache keepalive config, per-session beat counters, and recent ledger lines

```sh

pai daemon status
```

See also: `pai daemon logs`, `pai daemon uninstall`

### pai daemon quiet

Pause background maintenance for benchmark or overnight runs

```
pai daemon quiet ACTION [options]
```

Pause background maintenance for benchmark or overnight runs.

While quiet the daemon defers the registry scan, index and embed passes, triple extraction, the nightly maintenance cycle and disk housekeeping. Each deferred kind runs once when quiet ends (off, or --until reached). Session notes, summaries and the context handover keep running.

| Argument | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `ACTION` | yes | on, off or status |

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--until HH:MM` | string | — | With `on`: end quiet at the next HH:MM local time |

```sh
pai daemon quiet on
pai daemon quiet on --until 07:00
pai daemon quiet off
pai daemon quiet status
```

See also: `pai daemon status`
